items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, I know that old man. Slowdrag's just about, oh, something like 70 this year, I think. I'll be doggone. [INTERVIEWEE] The Glenny was 18 years older, yeah.

ctx.x: Hmm. Well, he was older than, uh... Uh... Uh... What do you mean? What am I trying to call? Slowdrag? Oh, Slowdrag. Oh, yeah.
He's a lot older than Slowdrag. Oh, yeah. Yeah, I know that old man. Slowdrag's just about, oh, something like 70 this year, I think. I'll be doggone.
